Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 38 (CloudHQ VA missing-address campaign): found new two source aggregator agreement plus a neighboring rows independent corroboration that outweighs a prior sessions single source proximity concern, applied the address while preserving that prior caution, refreshed company history from the operators own about and founder pages, flagged a second CloudHQ name collision on Wikipedia not present in a prior sessions notes. research_status remains complete.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CloudHQ, the data center operator, was established in 2016 by Hossein Fateh, per the operators own current about page (cloudhq.com/about/) fetched fresh this session. Fateh previously served as CEO and co-founder of DuPont Fabros Technology, a data center company that sold for 7.8 billion dollars in 2017, and has built and operated more than 700 MW of data center capacity across his career, per CloudHQs own founder page (cloudhq.com/learn-about-our-founder/), also fetched fresh this session. CloudHQ operates as part of the Fateh Family Office, alongside affiliated companies CloudCapital, WindHQ, and Dalian Development, per the operators own about page. The company maintains three regional headquarters, a global headquarters in Washington DC, an EMEA headquarters in London, and an APAC headquarters in Singapore. Per the operators own current about page, CloudHQ now describes 23 global campuses, more than 1,380 MW of contracted critical IT load with more than 6,000 MW of expansion potential, more than 30 million square feet of global data center portfolio, and more than 330 employees. A prior research pass on these rows had already flagged that the domain cloudhq.net resolves to an unrelated Google Workspace and Gmail backup software company, not this data center operator, and correctly redirected to cloudhq.com. This session found a second, separate name collision worth flagging for a future researcher: the Wikipedia article at en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CloudHQ describes yet another different, unrelated company, a cloud data synchronization tool for Google Workspace founded in 2011 by Senad Dizdar and based in San Francisco, not this Ashburn and Manassas Virginia data center operator founded by Hossein Fateh. That Wikipedia article was checked this session and found not to apply, so it is not used or cited as a source here, and no Wikipedia sourced company history is included in this reading. A prior research pass on this row found a single aggregator, DataCenterMap, giving an address of 44621 Waxpool Rd, but flagged this as a likely data quality issue because this rows own OSM coordinates sit roughly 200 meters from the registrys LC1, LC3, and LC4 rows, which that prior pass believed were all on or near Loudoun County Parkway, not Waxpool Road. This session found new corroborating evidence that updates that assessment rather than deleting it: datacenterHawks own dedicated LC2 listing independently gives the identical 44621 Waxpool Road, a second agreeing source, and this registrys LC3 row, also in this immediate cluster, independently carries its own two source agreeing Waxpool Road address, 44631, only ten digits away. Two aggregators agreeing on this exact number, plus a directly neighboring row in the same registry independently landing on the same street ten digits off, together outweigh the earlier single source proximity concern, so the Waxpool Road address is applied here, with the prior sessions original caution preserved in this note rather than removed.
